label: Historical Location
description: Period settings from medieval to mid-century. Tagged 'historical' for genre-filtered templates.

items.name: medieval-market
items.text: A bustling medieval market square, timber-framed houses leaning over stalls of cloth, produce and ironwork.

items.name: castle-great-hall
items.text: A stone castle great hall with banners hanging between torch sconces, long oak tables and a raised dais.

items.name: victorian-street
items.text: A fog-touched Victorian street of soot-darkened brick, gas lamps and hand-painted shopfront signs.

items.name: speakeasy
items.text: A hidden 1920s speakeasy behind an unmarked door, velvet booths, a brass-railed bar and a small jazz stage.

items.name: roman-forum
items.text: The colonnaded forum of a Roman city at its height, marble temples and bronze statues under a Mediterranean sky.

items.name: age-of-sail-harbor
items.text: A crowded age-of-sail harbor, tall ships at anchor, rope and cargo crates stacked along wooden quays.

items.name: edo-street
items.text: An Edo-period street of wooden machiya townhouses, noren curtains and paper lanterns above a packed-earth road.

items.name: wild-west-mainstreet
items.text: A dusty frontier main street with a saloon, hitching posts and a water tower against open prairie.

items.name: belle-epoque-cafe
items.text: A Belle Époque Parisian café terrace, wicker chairs, marble tables and art-nouveau ironwork under an awning.

items.name: fifties-diner
items.text: A chrome-and-neon 1950s American diner, checkerboard floor, red vinyl booths and a long counter with stools.

items.name: ruined-city-road
items.text: A crumbling ancient stone road weaving through the ruins of a forgotten city, ivy and moss reclaiming the fallen columns.

items.name: gothic-cathedral-nave
items.text: A Gothic cathedral nave, clustered columns rising into rib vaults, incense drifting through colored shafts of light from the stained-glass clerestory.

items.name: grand-bazaar
items.text: A vaulted grand bazaar, painted arches over lamplit stalls of carpets, brass and spice sacks, dust glowing in the air between the crowds.

items.name: steam-era-platform
items.text: A steam-era railway platform, a locomotive exhaling white clouds beneath the iron canopy, porters' trolleys stacked with leather trunks.

items.name: coaching-inn-yard
items.text: The galleried courtyard of a Tudor coaching inn, timber balconies on oak posts above cobbles rutted by carriage wheels, a mounting block beside the entrance arch.

items.name: monastery-scriptorium
items.text: A monastery scriptorium, slanted oak desks beneath high windows, inkhorns and quills beside gilded manuscripts weighted open under candle sconces.

items.name: ancient-egypt-temple
items.text: an ancient Egypt temple hall of massive painted columns, hieroglyphs cut deep and light dropping through clerestory slots
items.text_short: ancient Egyptian hall of painted columns

items.name: ancient-greece-agora
items.text: an ancient Greece agora with colonnaded stoa along one side, marble bright in the sun and awnings over the traders
items.text_short: ancient Greek agora under a colonnaded stoa

items.name: byzantine-interior
items.text: a Byzantine interior of gold mosaic ground and a dome on pendentives, figures standing flat and frontal against the gold
items.text_short: Byzantine gold mosaic under a pendentive dome

items.name: viking-longhouse
items.text: a Viking age longhouse with a turf roof and a central hearth, smoke finding the roof hole and benches down both long walls
items.text_short: Viking longhouse, central hearth under a turf roof

items.name: elizabethan-hall
items.text: an Elizabethan great hall in linenfold panelling, a hammerbeam roof overhead and a long table set below the dais
items.text_short: Elizabethan hall, linenfold under a hammerbeam roof

items.name: prehistoric-cave
items.text: a prehistoric painted cave, ochre and charcoal animals following the rock's own contours, torchlight reaching only part of the wall
items.text_short: prehistoric painted cave following the rock's contours

items.name: bronze-age-settlement
items.text: a Bronze Age settlement of round huts inside a ditched enclosure, thatch blackened at the apex and livestock penned between
items.text_short: Bronze Age round huts in a ditched enclosure

items.name: iron-age-hillfort
items.text: an Iron Age hillfort ringed by earth ramparts and ditches, a timber gateway and the whole country visible from the top
items.text_short: Iron Age hillfort ringed by earth ramparts

items.name: baroque-era-salon
items.text: a Baroque era salon of gilded stucco and a painted ceiling, tall mirrors doubling a room already too full of ornament
items.text_short: Baroque salon, gilded stucco under a painted ceiling

items.name: roman-empire-villa
items.text: a villa of the Roman empire around a colonnaded peristyle, mosaic floors and a shallow pool, frescoed walls in deep red
items.text_short: Roman empire villa around a colonnaded peristyle
